# freshdesk_email_config (Data Source)

Look up a single email config by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_email_config" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the email config to look up.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the config is in use.
- `created_at` (String) When the config was created (RFC 3339).
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the group tickets are assigned to.
- `name` (String) Name of the email config.
- `primary_role` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default support address.
- `product_id` (Number) ID of the product the config belongs to.
- `reply_email` (String) Address replies are sent from.
- `to_email` (String) Address customers write to.
- `updated_at` (String) When the config was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `workspace_id` (Number) ID of the workspace the config belongs to.
